rulings.why: Invested trait present, so the passive lane actually fires; 'see clearly into the Ethereal Plane, 60 feet' is a standing owner-only sense and the record has no passiveEffects. Free-text sense names are the shipped convention (robe-of-eyes 'see the unseen', eye-slash 'see four times farther than normal').

Invested, and the glow is an always-on warning only the owner perceives — not the once-per-hour blinding burst. acuity is display-only (derive.ts:826 uses it solely to rank duplicate senses), so 'vague' cannot over-grant a number.

The gap is real (a wooden buckler with Hardness 3 / HP 6 / BT 3 that the record types as plain equipment) but the judge's empty-modifier mode cannot deliver it: derive.ts:584 finds a shield by itemType === 'shield', so no Raise-a-Shield, no AC, no Shield Block. Re-typed as engine work, matching how greater-energized-shield was handled.

fix.note: Needs itemType 'shield' with acBonus 1, hardness 3, hp 6, brokenThreshold 3 (a wooden buckler). derive.ts:584 selects the raised shield by itemType === 'shield' and the audit applier will not overwrite itemType, so a mode or a field write cannot deliver it. The collapsed/unfurled toggle can stay in the description once the base statistics exist.

rulings.why: OVERTURNED. The '+1' is the fundamental-rune lane, which every sibling verdict correctly ruled needs nothing (final-blade, flaying-knife, gut-ripper, hells-judgement, hunters-bow, glacier-hammer, gluttonous-spear all say the potency lives on the inventory instance's runes). The proposed entry is not situational at all — its 'when' is an instruction to the player, and starring strikeAttack with '+1 item' double-reports the potency the owner etches. The weapon statistics (1d8 piercing, spear, thrown 20) are already on the record.

Text gives YOU resistance 10 to siege-weapon damage; the base record ships passiveEffects.resistances value 5 and the duplicate major-flag-of-the-stronghold ships value 10 in exactly this shape. Pure consistency fix, right lane, right value.

Real grant (a new fist Strike) in the right lane, but the die string is wrong: deriveUnarmedStrike builds damage as `${dice}${die}`, so die '1d6' renders '11d6'. The dominant corpus convention is the bare face ('d4' x58, 'd6' x69, 'd8' x21); the nine '1dN' records are the buggy minority.

A lasting, player-toggled movement change on the owner, mode-gated by fromItemId (the item exists) and holding the standing 20 rather than the activated 40, so it cannot over-grant. speeds.fly on a mode is the shipped shape (mode 'klingegeist').

Clumsy 1 while wielding is a standing owner-side condition and nothing carries it. A note-only mode is this codebase's declared handling for clumsy — verified: modes 'giants-stature', 'dire-form' and 'item-hydra-mutagen' all state clumsy 1 in the note with no modifier. The target-side -2 on the grabbed creature was correctly left out.

The +1d6 vs giants is genuinely carried nowhere, but items['giant-killing'].situational is the wrong lane and would be inert: explain.ts authoredSituational only reads db.items[inv.itemId].situational for an inventory item that is worn/equipped/invested, while etching CONSUMES the rune item. The star would show only while the rune sat unused and vanish the moment it started working — the exact failure the comment at explain.ts:198 was written to prevent. Etched runes reach the sheet through FEAT_SITUATIONAL keyed by rune id (22 rune ids already live there), which is source code the applier cannot write.

fix.note: Belongs in FEAT_SITUATIONAL['giant-killing'] in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, not in core.json: [{targets:[{kind:'strikeDamage'}], when:'on a Strike against a giant with this weapon', bonus:'+1d6'}]. characterSituationalIds() pushes etched property-rune ids and looks them up in that registry; authoredSituational() only covers inventory items, so a core.json write is silent once the rune is etched. RuneDef.damage is unconditional and must NOT be used — that would grant the 1d6 against every target.

rulings.why: Same real gap, same wrong lane as the lesser rune — an item-record situational cannot reach an etched rune.

fix.note: Belongs in FEAT_SITUATIONAL['giant-killing-greater'] in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts: [{targets:[{kind:'strikeDamage'}], when:'on a Strike against a giant with this weapon', bonus:'+2d6'}]. Not RuneDef.damage, which is unconditional.

rulings.why: An invested graft whose whole content is a permanent owner capability. Confirmed no lane exists: ItemPassiveEffects declares skills/perception/saves/ac/attack/senses/speeds/resistances/immunities/speedPenalty/speedBonus/loreBonus/grantsLanguages and nothing for breathing, and this graft grants no swim Speed to stand in for it. Correctly routed to engine work rather than faked.

'Any hit with this maul deals 1 extra cold damage' is unconditional and intrinsic, and derive.ts:1498 passes a weapon's own strikeDamage as the per-weapon rider, so the fix lands on this maul's Strike only. Shape matches StrikeDamageRider (type/flat/appliesTo/note). The judge correctly left the potency and the dice-valued activation alone.

The 1d6 precision vs a target that can't see you is a real owner-side conditional rider carried nowhere, and the record is an equipped weapon so item.situational reaches the sheet. situational is display-only by construction (situationalBonuses.ts: 'nothing here changes a computed number'), so the light-tier entry cannot over-grant — it only warns that an etched +2 striking is a bright-light overstatement.

`stuck` is a declared ItemBase field read by cursedItems.ts:65 (db.items[inv.itemId]?.stuck) and no item in the corpus uses it yet, so this is the lane's first correct user, not an invented field. The judge also correctly declined disguisedAs, since gloves-of-storing is not in the database.

'you gain 1d8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute' on a critical hit is owner-side and conditional; kind 'hp' is a legal SituationalTarget and the spear is an equipped weapon, so it displays. The +1 striking returning is correctly left to the rune lane.

A 10-minute owner-side -2 item penalty to Stealth to Hide and Sneak, printed with that exact bonus type. Mode is item-gated by a real fromItemId, the modifier names the penalty type the text names, and the Leap/light riders are in the note.

A real granted unarmed Strike on an invested graft, and die 'd8' is the correct bare-face form. But the traits list omits 'unarmed': collectGrantedNaturals copies traits verbatim and deriveUnarmedStrike only defaults to ['unarmed'] when the list is EMPTY, so a horn with ['forceful','shove'] would not read as an unarmed attack. Added, plus 'magical' to match the item's own trait, as phantom-shroud and whip-tail do.

The aura explicitly reads 'whenever you or an ally', so it is not an ally-only effect; the bearer holds the banner and stands in his own aura. 1d6 persistent fire on a critical hit is owner-side and conditional, carried nowhere, and situational is display-only so the value cannot be double-counted.

Verified: the record is itemType 'equipment' with no category, group or damage, while the base 'chainbreaker' record IS correctly typed — so this is a variant-import defect, not a rules judgement. The proposed statistics match the pick (martial, pick group, 1d6 piercing, fatal-d10, 1 hand). Correctly routed to engine work since the applier will not overwrite itemType and every Strike path gates on it.

Same verified variant-import defect (itemType 'equipment', no weapon statistics), but the note misstates the category: a longspear is a SIMPLE weapon (core.json items['longspear'].category === 'simple'), not martial. Note corrected so the re-type pass does not write the wrong proficiency.

fix.note: Family-variant import defect: needs itemType 'weapon', category 'simple' (a longspear is a simple weapon — core.json items['longspear'] is category simple, group spear, 1d8 piercing, reach, hands 2), group 'spear', damage 1d8 piercing, trait reach, hands 2. itemType cannot be overwritten by the audit applier and every Strike path gates on it.

rulings.why: Verified: itemType 'equipment' with no acBonus/hardness/hp/brokenThreshold, and derive.ts:584 selects the raised shield by itemType === 'shield', so it can never be Raised or Shield Blocked. The proposed numbers match a steel shield (acBonus 2) under a minor reinforcing rune (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32), exactly as printed.
Same printed -2 item penalty to Stealth to Hide and Sneak for 10 minutes as the base wings, on a distinct record with its own real fromItemId; the added glide is correctly note-only.

'whenever you or an ally ... critically succeeds with a Strike against an off-guard target' includes the bearer; the 1d6 precision rider is owner-side, conditional, and carried nowhere. Display-only lane, so no arithmetic is changed.

Verified: itemType 'equipment' with no armor statistics, while the base 'mitigation-mail' record IS correctly typed itemType 'armor' — a variant-import defect. The proposed numbers match core.json items['chain-mail'] exactly (medium, chain, acBonus 4, dexCap 1, checkPenalty -2, speedPenalty -5, strength 3).
Same verified defect as greater-mitigation-mail — 'equipment' with no AC while the base reactive-mail is correctly typed 'armor'. Chain mail figures check out against items['chain-mail'].

Every spell id in the fix exists in core.spells (checked all thirteen), and the shape is byte-for-byte the one the base record ships: staff-of-arcane-might carries the same heldSpells map plus counters [{id:'pool',label:'Charges',max:'level',resetsOnRest:true,startsFull:true}]. build.ts:2908 reads heldSpells off ANY inventory item regardless of itemType, so the spell list delivers even before the re-type.

hydraulic-torrent exists in core.spells and is primal-only, so the named tradition is right; the greater variant's printed rank is 6th; the record carries the invested trait, which is what build.ts:2953 requires before reading an item's innateSpells. The 1/day frequency already on the record supplies the tracker.

The spell is cast ON YOU, illusory-disguise exists in core.spells (arcane/occult, so the named tradition is legal), the record carries the invested trait the innate lane requires, and the absence of any frequency line on this variant is confirmed against the base record, which does carry frequency 1/day plus a counter. atWill therefore matches the printed text rather than over-granting.

'Instead of the tool's usual bonus, you take a -2 circumstance penalty to checks made using heckling tools' is a standing owner-side modifier with the bonus type printed. skill/'all' is a legal target detail and is used by shipped entries, the trigger text scopes it, and the intelligent item's own Perception/skills were correctly excluded as the ITEM's statistics.

An automatic success is strictly more than permission to attempt, so this is not the mundane-tool case; Conceal an Object is a Stealth action and free-text outcome phrases are an established bonus value in this registry. The searcher's Perception check was correctly left on the other side of the screen.

The extra 1d6 on a critical hit against a target that can't see you is owner-side and doubly conditional, so it belongs in situational rather than flat damage — and the judge correctly refused to model the '+1 magic shortbow' potency, which is the rune lane. Equipped weapon, so the star displays.

The record carries the fortune trait, and the effect is explicitly on YOUR saving throw ('the result of your saving throw is one degree of success better'). save/'all' is legal, the entry is not dcOnly so it stars the save rather than the DC, and the grimoire capacity was correctly left out.

Not a one-moment activation — 2nd-rank water walk runs up to 10 minutes on the wearer. water-walk exists in core.spells and includes arcane among its traditions; the cloak carries the invested trait the item-innate lane requires; the 1/day frequency already on the record tracks the use. The azarketi week-out-of-water clause was correctly left as flavour.

'as long as they possess their immaculate instrument, they treat any critical failures with these skills as failures' is a standing owner-side degree-of-success floor. 'performance' and 'crafting' are both real skill keys in SKILLS, and the once-per-month mythic-proficiency attempt and Destruction clause were correctly left to the table.

The gap is real — core.runes['impactful'] carries no `damage` while core.runes['flaming'] does, and derive.ts:1487/1694 read exactly db.runes[p]?.damage — but the fix cannot land where the judge intended. The applier writes only into core.items, so this would set core.items['impactful'].damage on an itemType 'equipment' record: inert (every Strike path gates on itemType === 'weapon') and misleading, since `damage` on an item means that item's own weapon damage.

fix.note: The write target is core.runes['impactful'].damage = {dice:1,die:'d6',type:'force'}, NOT core.items['impactful']. scripts/apply-item-audit.mjs only writes core.items[id][field], so this needs a runes-aware pass (or a hand edit to core.json plus the matching entry in the data-pipeline rune source, since anything not carried through the overlay dies at the next `npm run data`). The 5-foot push on a critical hit is target-side and stays out.

rulings.why: Identical real gap and identical mis-targeting: core.runes['impactful-greater'] has no `damage`, and an items[] write would be inert. The damage rider is the same 1d6 force; only the crit push distance differs, and that is target-side.

fix.note: Write target is core.runes['impactful-greater'].damage = {dice:1,die:'d6',type:'force'}, not core.items['impactful-greater']. Same runes-aware pass as 'impactful'.

rulings.why: Unlike the other relic gifts in this pool the numbers are fixed and printed — heatsight, precise, 30 feet, 1 minute — so nothing is GM-scaled. fromItemId resolves to a real item, and mode.senses with a duration is the shape item-bloodhound-mask-lesser and item-clockwork-goggles already ship.
